text:
A student heats hydrated copper(II) sulfate. The blue crystals change to a white powder.
How can the student reverse this reaction?
Add anhydrous copper(II) sulfate to the white powder.
A
B
Add water to the white powder.
C
Cool the white powder.
D
Reheat the white powder.

options.label: A
options.text: Add anhydrous copper(II) sulfate to the white powder.

options.label: B
options.text: Add water to the white powder.
